name: Osananajimi no Onee-chan wa Senzoku Maid! ~Natsuyasumi Dousei Seikatsu~
original_name: 幼馴染のお姉ちゃんは専属メイド！～夏休み同棲生活～
source:
Takehara Hideo is a perverted high school student who has an obsession with sex. He is befriended by Kanzaki Shion, a girl living next door. Hideo wants nothing more than to have sex with her, but Shion is firm and diligent and won't allow it.

Hideo dreams of living together with Shion and having sex with her all day long. Of course, Shion quite adamantly denies him his dream, but... Somewhere down the road her shouting becomes mixed with moans of ecstasy.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE033028.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
竹原秀夫是一名沉迷于性的变态高中生。他与住在隔壁的女孩神崎紫苑成为了朋友。秀夫只想与她发生性关系，但紫苑坚决而勤奋，不允许这样做。

秀夫梦想着与紫苑同居并整天与她发生性关系。当然，紫苑坚决否认他的梦想，但是……在路上的某个地方，她的叫喊声中夹杂着狂喜的呻吟。
